about: Gate 0 fight configs (test/gate0/harness.mjs startFight). Every script runs under every config at every seed listed.

configs.about: A fresh frankendom.com visitor's career fight at 82a994d15: Match.begin('career') (src/fight/match.ts:144-176). Era flags as begin() sets them; level 1 Veteran (the Centurion); the visitor's default skill, stance and SPECIAL 2; Special Moves on (recordSpecials({ specials: true, level: 1, opponent: 'veteran' })).

The fight V3 plays (data/fight.json): the first career fight of a V1 page load, which V1 fights at the Match's default level (PRESET_LEVEL.normal, 18), so the Centurion has the gladius and scutum (moves.ts LOADOUT_FROM). Otherwise as 'career'.

The fight V3 plays by default (data/fight.json `ai`: novice): 'page-first' with data/brains.json row novice laid over the level-18 Centurion's V1 profile (src/brain.ts). Both sides get the same profile object built from their own profileAt, so V3 must still replay V1 tick for tick.
The base rules: plain initialPractice(seed, opponentAt(OPPONENTS.veteran, 1)), no Special Moves, no stances, the era flags off (old full-size circle, no late notice, no stab rule, no stance rows).
